feature_under_test: an exact persisted daily cutoff and its first execution dispatch survive an Atoll Server outage that crosses the cutoff before the execution daemon reconnects

environment.mysql: ephemeral MySQL 8.4 with separate non-root migration and runtime accounts
processes: Atoll Server process restarted in place
one execution daemon OS process kept alive

fault_cut.cut: kill Atoll Server after the Recruiting Actor is ready and before cutoff; wait until two seconds after cutoff; verify MySQL still has zero DailyRuns; pause the surviving daemon while Server restarts
fault_cut.post_restart_pre_daemon_gate: the overdue timer creates the original DailyRun and a Listing dispatch; that dispatch is pending with at least one delivery attempt while recruiting_attempts remains empty
fault_cut.resume: continue the same daemon OS process and require configured-fleet presence to accelerate the pending dispatch

first_run_finding.facts: the original DailyRun and SourceOccurrence existed, but the Listing Work stayed open with zero Attempts; its dispatch had one delivery attempt, last_error_class awaiting_completion, and next_attempt_at about 15 minutes later
first_run_finding.root_cause: presence tracking only knew Executors that had already claimed an Attempt; the first post-cutoff dispatch had no Attempt, so the daemon's later arrival could not invoke the existing durable-dispatch acceleration path

invariants: the daily timer is persisted before the fault and no application side channel runs while Server is offline
the overdue timer retains its original schedule date, cutoff, window, policy version, and deterministic DailyRun identity
DailyRun and SourceOccurrence are each created exactly once
the first post-outage dispatch is observed pending and already posted while there is no Attempt
the configured Executor's concrete incarnation becomes a bounded presence observation and accelerates the existing pending dispatch
the same daemon process then completes one Listing, twenty Details, twenty response Resources, and the DailyRun
a final normal Server restart preserves the summary and Resource read

implementation.scaling_bound: configured Executor bases and the Atoll actor catalog are indexed in O(fleet+catalog), with the existing configuration limit of 10000 targets
implementation.reused_mechanism: existing concrete-incarnation presence transition, AccelerateExecutorDispatches transaction, idempotent dispatch identity, Offer receipt and Attempt fence

non_claims: simultaneous Atoll Server and MySQL failure
multiple missed calendar days during an extended outage
20K simultaneous Listing occurrences or 400K Detail completion
remote Artifact storage, third-party latency, rate limits, or site availability

acceptance.gate: P9 Atoll unavailable across the daily cutoff with execution fleet reconnecting later
